com.zynthec.zLoader.name: zLoader
com.zynthec.zLoader.subtitle: Independent SideStore fork for iPhone and iPad.
com.zynthec.zLoader.localizedDescription: Sideloading and manage apps, deveoloper profiles and much more in zynthec style.
com.zynthec.zLoader.versionDescription: Retain profile-authorized capabilities and omit ungranted application rights instead of blocking installation. Reuse matching existing and wildcard profiles. Missing HealthKit and increased-memory rights no longer prevent LiveContainer signing.
